title: Door locking and compression seals on a gas-fired furnace for large dished heads
summary: Locking a raised door, compressing its seals after closing, and releasing bogie seals before movement are different states. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s gas-fired bogie-hearth furnace proposal dated 17 June 2022 separately lists door safety pins, pneumatic perimeter compression seals and bogie side seals, with interlocked actions. “Door in position” does not mean all these actions are complete. Define each mechanism, feedback signal and permitted action separately.
